content_digest_basis: SHA-256 of RFC-8259-compatible canonical JSON for all fields except content_digest; UTF-8, sorted keys, compact separators, no NaN

input.missing_gene_policy: zero-fill only after the minimum overlap check passes

preprocessing.normalization: source scaled TPM (1e4 multiplier, intentionally 100x below conventional 1e6)

article.authors: Thomas MPH, Ajaib S, Tanner G, Bulpitt AJ, Stead LF
article.title: GBMPurity: A machine learning tool for estimating glioblastoma tumor purity from bulk RNA-sequencing data

provenance.training_summary: Upstream reports simulated pseudobulk tumours derived from the GBmap single-cell resource; no training records are included in this artifact.
provenance.transformation_notice: GLIO-PROTEOGEN converted the six exact pretrained PyTorch float32 storages and the ordered input-gene table into deterministic JSON. The converter does not execute the source pickle, retrain the model, or redistribute source single-cell/pseudobulk training records. This adaptation is not endorsed by the upstream authors.
provenance.upstream_disclaimer: Research use only; not for clinical decision making. The upstream authors state that the model is unsuitable outside its primary IDH-wildtype glioblastoma context.

source_lock.archive_format: PyTorch ZIP serialization; pickle metadata was inspected but never executed
